name: 2nd Kup

practical.title: Patterns of the grading examiner's choice
One Step Sparring (Ilbo Matsoki)
practical.detail: Red belts develop their own techniques, see sparring

theory.question: What is 3 step sparring
theory.answer: A drill for beginners to learn basic techniques. It teaches correct distance, facing, forearm conditioning, blocks, stances, counter attacks and timing.

sparring: ONE STEP SPARRING (ILBO MATSOKI): Both attacker and defender start in parallel ready position; attacker steps forward with right leg into walking stance and punches with right hand. On the second occasion the same attacker steps forward with left leg and left hand punching.
Red belts are expected to develop their own techniques on one step sparring using these guidelines (not in any set order): 1. Hand only. 2. Foot only. 3. Hand and foot. 4. Foot and hand. 5. Jumping.

otherSections.heading: Sheet note
items: Variations of the grading format are at the examiner's discretion; the sheet is for guidance only.

otherSections.heading: Hwa-Rang pattern summary
items: 29 movements; starts in closed ready stance C; named for the Hwa-Rang youth group of the Silla Dynasty (about 600 AD); 29 refers to the 29th Infantry Division.

otherSections.heading: Quiz question on page
items: Q: What is 'Straight Fingertip Thrust' in Korean? A: Sun Sonkut Tulgi
